name: e0-planner-fixture-v1
note: Template, hashes only. The owner fills indexSha256 (the exposed r3 run's context/research/index.json), briefSha256 (the r3 task brief), sourceIdsSha256 (sha256 of the canonical JSON array of the index's sourceId values in ascending UTF-16 order), sourceCount and mandatorySourceChunks (the chunk count in that run's coverage.json), then sets status to pinned. The index and the brief stay under the ignored .soar; scripts/planner-fixture.ts refuses a template or a mismatch before any request. The three conditions and the 3 x 10 design are a proposal for the E0 card.
